messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Match the shape and styling of the hair in the reference images, while retaining the current person's facial features, hair color, and clothing. Leave the rest of the video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Match the shape and styling of the hair in the reference images, while retaining the current person's facial features, hair color, and clothing. Leave the rest of the video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in profile, then turns her body and head, raises her arms to touch her hair, and lowers them back to her sides.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body side view keeps the character centered in frame.","clothing":"She wears a dark gray sleeveless vest over a white long-sleeved shirt, maroon flared pants, and dark shoes.","hair_color":"Bright purple.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled up into a high ponytail with a small tuft at the back of the head.","identity":"A slender 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, shown mostly in profile.","scene":"An outdoor paved area with a metal guardrail, trees, rocks, and a fence in the background under bright daylight."},"uncertain":["The character's exact facial features are not clearly visible due to the side profile and distance."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's hair was restyled from a short cropped look to a high ponytail with a small tuft at the back, while the purple color, clothing, scene, and motion remained largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's hairstyle to match the reference images, retaining facial features, purple hair color, and clothing while leaving the rest unchanged.
uncertain: Exact match to the reference hairstyle is difficult to judge from the side-view video.
unexpected_changes: The new hairstyle does not clearly match the reference's short sides and long top/front styling; it appears more like a generic high ponytail.
